Calderhead is a leading UK provider of temperature-controlled storage and distribution
Calderhead is a family-owned business that provides high quality solutions for multi-temperature logistics issues.
Established in 1993, Calderhead delivers a complete end to end temperature-controlled logistics solution; storage, distribution and value added services tailored to their customers' requirements.
Operating from our BRCGS AA* certified site, centrally located in the Midlands, we have a modern fleet of vehicles ranging from vans to 44 tonne artics with tracking and temperature controlled monitoring technology.
We aim to make our customers more successful by nurturing long term partnerships, delivering sustainable logistics solutions which benefit our customers, people and the environment.

Specialists in temperature controlled logistics
Refrigerated transport, Food delivery services, Cold storage and warehousing services for clients throughout the UK.
As a family run business we pride ourselves on being small enough to care about each of our customers and people, and to be flexible to their individual needs; but big enough that this doesn't mean our customers need to compromise on services that we provide.
Temperature controlled transport, storage and warehousing services for clients throughout the UK
.. up-to-date warehouse management software provides full traceability from receipt to delivery...
With over 30 years experience, Calderhead is a family owned and managed business and one of the UK's leading providers of temperature controlled logistics.
We provide frozen, chilled and ambient storage and value added warehouse services along with national temperature controlled distribution throughout the UK, from our centrally located, BRCGS certified site in Redditch, Worcestershire.
We provide a variety of temperature controlled distribution solutions from consolidated multidrop deliveries, scheduled throughout the UK to dedicated full loads or case and sample deliveries to suit your requirements.
We operate a large modern fleet of vehicles ranging from 3.5 ton vans, rigids, urban trailers and articulated vehicles with multi-temperature and tail-lift options. Vehicles are fitted with the latest tracking and temperature control monitoring technology.
Our centrally located, BRCGS certified purpose built site offers frozen, chill and ambient storage facilities. In addition, we provide a variety of value added warehouse services. Using the most up-to-date warehouse management software we provide full traceability from receipt to delivery and our customers have direct access to live stock through a customer portal.
Our covered loading area and loading bays provide ideal facilities for cross dock and container loading / unloading.
Tailor-made solutions to customer challenges
We do not take the "one size fits all" approach and can react quickly and flexibly to find solutions that match any challenges you have.
